bio.text: Ramses Frias, a community activist, ran as a Republican for New York City Council District 25 in Queens in 2025 and is a candidate for the 39th Assembly District in 2026.
QNS reported that he was born and raised in Elmhurst, Queens.
The Queens County Republican Party's candidate page says he attended public school in the area.

sources.title: Shekar Krishnan faces Democratic, Republican challengers in District 25 City Council race
